# Clear Safe Router

> Provider-free React SPA router with file-based routing and compile-time type-safe navigation. The navigation kernel is framework-free and can be driven by other view adapters through a `RouterEnv` platform seam.

## Start Here

- [README](README.md): User-facing setup, route conventions, loaders, caching, blockers, actions, prefetching, scroll restoration, and deployment.
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): Repository commands, architecture, core isolation rules, testing, and definition of done.
- [Package manifest](package.json): Scripts, dependencies, peer dependencies, and published subpaths.
- [Playground](playground/): Main manual test app; route tree is generated from `playground/routes`.

## Public Entry Points

- [React API](src/index.tsx): Root `clear-safe-router` barrel: `Router`, `Link`, route helpers, hooks, and public types.
- [Headless core](src/core/index.ts): `clear-safe-router/core`; curated framework-free API for navigation, matching, loaders, guards, caching, actions, and state.
- [Browser environment](src/browser-env.ts): `clear-safe-router/browser-env`; DOM implementation of `RouterEnv` reusable by non-React adapters.
- [Vite plugin](src/vite-plugin/index.ts): `clear-safe-router/vite`; generates the route tree and typed route registry.
- [Core build entry](src/core-entry.ts): Thin Rollup entry that re-exports `src/core`; contains no logic.

## Architecture

- [Core kernel](src/core/): Framework-free code. It must not import React, Vite, DOM types, or use `window`, `document`, `history`, or `import.meta`.
- [Platform seam](src/core/env.ts): `RouterEnv`, `nullEnv`, `setRouterEnv`, `getRouterEnv`, and structural DOM-free scroll types.
- [Core types](src/core/types.ts): Framework-free route, loader, cache, snapshot, and typed-destination types. `TypedRouterRouteMap` lives here.
- [React adapter](src/runtime/index.ts): Wires `browserEnv`, installs the adapter prefetch hook, sets the dev warning flag, and re-exports core APIs.
- [React hooks](src/runtime/hooks.ts): Adapter hooks over the core snapshot and stores.
- [Router component](src/router.tsx): Mounts the router, subscribes to popstate through `RouterEnv`, and starts revalidation.
- [Link component](src/link.tsx): Typed navigation, active/pending state, and prefetch behavior.
- [Route rendering](src/route/): `createFileRoute`, `getRoute`, `Outlet`, lazy components, and route context.
- [Route generator](scripts/generate-routes.mjs): Scans route files, validates conventions, writes `routeTree.gen.ts`, and augments `clear-safe-router/core`.
- [Type contract](tests/types/routes.test.tsx): Compile-time checks for typed routes, params, loader data, and navigation.

## Route Registry

- Generated apps augment `clear-safe-router/core`, not the root module.
- The root API re-exports core types, so `Link`, `useNavigate`, and route hooks remain typed from `clear-safe-router`.
- Do not hand-edit `playground/routeTree.gen.ts`; run `npm run router:generate`.
- Route conventions: `__root.tsx` is required; `index.tsx`, `route.tsx`, `$param.tsx`, and `$.tsx` are supported. See the README for the full table.

## Agent Skills

- [getting-started skill](https://github.com/AndrewBubnov/clear-safe-router/blob/main/skills/getting-started/SKILL.md): SKILL.md for AI coding agents — setup, mental model, the loading pipeline, and per-task references (routes and loaders, search params as URL state, navigation/blocking/invalidation). The source of truth lives in `skills/` (shipped in the npm tarball; `npx clear-safe-router skill install` copies it into `.claude/skills/`).

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm run dev                 # generate routes + start playground
npm run router:generate     # regenerate playground/routeTree.gen.ts
npm run typecheck           # generate + tsc -b + public type tests
npm run lint
npm test
npm run test:coverage
npm run test:e2e            # Playwright against the playground
npm run build:lib           # library JS + declarations
npm run build:playground
npm run build
```

For core-only changes, also run the no-DOM compile:

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler \
  --strict --skipLibCheck --lib ES2022 --types node src/core/index.ts
```

## Core Rules

- `src/core` is framework-free. Platform behavior belongs in `RouterEnv` implementations.
- Update `RouterEnv`, `nullEnv`, `browserEnv`, and test memory envs together when adding a platform method.
- Keep `src/core/index.ts` curated; do not expose cache maps, refs, or listener internals from the public core barrel.
- Preserve the root `clear-safe-router` API. Prefer additive changes; breaking changes require a major version.
- `RouterEnv` and `routerConfig.onPrefetch` are process-global: one adapter per process.
- `routerConfig.warnOnUnmatchedRoutes` and `routerConfig.warnOnHiddenChildren` default to `false`; the React adapter enables both when `process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production'` (the consumer's bundler replaces it with the consumer's own mode — never use `import.meta.env` in library code, the lib build bakes it).
- Core tests use `// @vitest-environment node`; React adapter tests use the default jsdom environment.
- `resetRouterState()` does not reset `RouterEnv` or `routerConfig`; restore them explicitly in tests.
- Do not commit `dist/`, `dist-playground/`, coverage, Playwright reports, or test results.
